original_phase7_test_regression_monitor.interpretation_note: This pre-existing test split is used only as a regression monitor; it has been previously inspected and is not a fresh final test.

scope: Separate shear-aware candidate initialized from the frozen Phase 6/7 checkpoint. The original checkpoint is unchanged. Original train data are replayed, original validation monitors retention, and new shear validation selects the model. New shear test states are used only after model selection.

shear_design.purpose: separate shear-aware fine-tuning; final-test states are excluded from fitting
shear_design.split_unit: deformation state; each state is repeated at every volume fraction

training_config.method: separate shear-aware fine-tune with original-data replay
training_config.selection: equal-weighted relative change in original validation and fresh shear validation objectives from frozen-model values
